gate.pass_message: PLAN.md is filled in and committed
gate.talk: One thing in the agent's plan you changed, and why?

levels.title: Build the prototype
levels.start: leave plan mode (Shift+Tab) and ask for step 1 of PLAN.md

gate.pass_message: the tool runs on your dataset

questions.prompt: Ask your leader for this level's question, then answer it in a word or two:
questions.wrong_hint: Read the column file for your dataset in data/, then look at the page again.

gate.talk: What did you see in the browser that the check couldn't?

levels.title: Test
levels.start: write three things that must not break in TESTS.md, before asking the agent

gate.pass_message: the tests pass and your work is committed
gate.talk: What did the agent's test plan cover that your list didn't, or the reverse?

levels.title: Review
levels.start: write two guesses in REVIEW.md, before asking for the review

gate.pass_message: the tests pass, the tool runs and your work is committed
gate.talk: What did the review find that the tests didn't?
gate.note: That was the last gate. PLAYBOOK.md is yours to take home: it works on any codebase, and the four skills in .claude/skills/ come with it.
